description: This file contains utility functions for managing project configurations, including filtering projects, building dependency maps, detecting circular dependencies, and collecting test files with support for ignore rules and gitignore parsing.

methods.name: wildcardPatternToRegExp
methods.description: Converts a wildcard pattern with '*' into a RegExp object.

methods.name: filterProjects
methods.description: Filters a list of projects based on provided project names or patterns, throwing errors if no matches or unknown names are found.

methods.name: buildTeardownToSetupsMap
methods.description: Builds a map linking teardown projects to their associated setup projects.

methods.name: buildProjectsClosure
methods.description: Builds a map representing project dependencies and their hierarchy, detecting circular dependencies.

methods.name: findTopLevelProjects
methods.description: Identifies top-level projects from a configuration based on project dependencies.

methods.name: buildDependentProjects
methods.description: Builds a set of projects that depend on the given projects, including transitive dependencies.

methods.name: collectFilesForProject
methods.description: Collects test files for a project, applying test match and ignore rules, with caching.
